# Get Page Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given Apple Pages Document.

## Syntax

~~~~text
pageDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, webpage: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
pageDetail(detail: pageDetail, webpage: Page Contents)
~~~~
